title: I built a PS1 style retro racing game
author: shash122tfu
selftext:
Hey folks I built a ps1 style retro racing game this week. If you like older style simple arcadey racing games you might like this one.

Its pretty complete tbh but let me know what you think!

Play it from your browser: [https://outpostracer.com/](https://outpostracer.com/)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/shash122tfu could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: shash122tfu
replies.body: I used chatgpt to create the game. I made it over 4 days, starting from this week. Just chatgpt via codex, must've done \~200-300 prompts.

comments.author: Mr-and-Mrs
comments.body: This is pretty awesome. It works well on mobile as well.

comments.author: PeterKuna
comments.body: lovely art style,  congrats on getting it done

comments.author: HopefulMeasurement25
comments.body:
Looks sick - I especially like the verticality and cambered twisty roads

it makes room for fun finding the fastest lines based on which part of the road ur on
